Nothing is imported or defined beyond rung4_refusal and carry_ladder. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

The batch loop in cairn/devices/tester/cli.py main() reads today, verbatim: 'for proof in proofs:' / 'rel = _rel(proof)' / 'if not proof.is_file(): print(f"  UNRUNNABLE  {proof}"); reds.append((proof, {})); continue' / 'isolation = isolation_for(proof)' / 'isolations[isolation] += 1' / 'try: record = tester.run_proof(proof, sink=sink, caller="cairn test", timeout=args.timeout, isolation=isolation, scratch_sweep=sweep_scratch() if sink == "validations" else None)' / 'except SealUnavailable as refusal: ... refused.append((proof, str(refusal))); continue'. reds, refused, sink and args are defined before the loop in main(). The change is two insertions and one edit, nothing else moves: (1) between the is_file() check's 'continue' and 'isolation = isolation_for(proof)' insert: 'ladder = None' / 'if sink == "validations":' / '    from cairn.devices.tester.reseal import carry_ladder, read_ladder, rung4_refusal' / '    why = rung4_refusal(proof, args.ruling)' / '    if why is not None:' / '        print(f"  REFUSED {rel}  (rung 4: its bytes moved under an open ladder)")' / '        refused.append((proof, why))' / '        continue' / '    ladder = read_ladder(proof)'. The check is a plain if before the run, not a wrapper; nothing is persisted for a refused proof because the run never happens. (2) in the try, the run_proof call's 'sink=sink' becomes 'sink="none" if ladder else sink', so a laddered proof's record is not persisted by run_proof; (3) directly after that call, still inside the try, add 'if ladder:' / '    record = carry_ladder(record, proof, ladder, ruling_id=args.ruling)', which persists the record itself. Everything after the try (persisted counts, verdict printing, reds) reads 'record' unchanged. Also: the --ruling help gains '(or a --seal)' and the usage block gains 'cairn test --seal --ruling <id> <path>      rung 4: the same gate, asked by the plain seal'. The run's exit stays the existing 'return 1 if (reds or refused) else 0'. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
